description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UserNotFoundException' used for handling cases where a user is not found in the system, specifically within the Identity infrastructure of the eShopWeb application.

classes.name: UserNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class that inherits from System.Exception, used to indicate that a user with the specified username was not found.

methods.name: UserNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of UserNotFoundException with a message indicating the username that was not found.
